source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gene expression (PDF 130).

blocks.text: Aap jaante hain ke gene DNA strand par nucleotides ka aik khaas sequence hai jo aik polypeptide (protein) banane ki hidayat deta hai. Doosre lafzon mein, gene apne aap ko "express" (zahir) aise karta hai ke woh aik protein ya enzyme banwata hai, aur yeh protein ya enzyme kisi khaas khasiyat (trait) ki nashonuma ko control karta hai.
Tamam jandar genes ko express karne ka aik hi bunyadi tareeqa istemal karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Gene apne aap ko kaise "express" karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aik protein ya enzyme banwa kar, jo phir kisi khaas khasiyat (trait) ki nashonuma ko control karta hai.

items: Gene expression: gene ke nucleotide sequence se polypeptide (protein) banna; sab jandaron mein aik hi tareeqa.
